run.command: strata bench run --profile /home/<user>/.config/strata/t630/strata-iq3_s.json --no-start --credential-env STRATA_KEY --track custom --track-notes Strata 0.2.7 official Linux release, engine 0.1.52. Tuned: both cards, layer_split 25 + --trim-stage-weights, --prefill 16384, --spec 4 --spec-min-p 0.7, --vram-reserve-mib 1400, --adapt-async 1, conversation cache 40 GiB/16 slots, STRATA_PREFILL_CPU_SHARE=auto with MAX 4096, numactl --interleave=all, 250 W per card, model GGUFs in /dev/shm. See bench/results/2026-10-28-community-t630-2x3090-pcie3/README.md. --background headless server; production server for a coding agent, idle during the run
